concept: Событие: день родео на ярмарке — наездники борются за золотую пряжку и синюю ленту под крики трибун.

cards.label: Lasso
cards.key_features: a neat round coil of twisted rope with a medium open loop resting on top of the coil; the whole lasso is compact and roughly round overall, not stretched out
cards.pose: The coil is tilted diagonally, seen slightly from above, with the loop lying over it toward the upper right

cards.label: Hay Bale
cards.key_features: straw texture, two tight twine bands around the bale
cards.pose: We look down at the bale at about 40 degrees, the horseshoe leaning on its front side

cards.label: Blue Ribbon
cards.key_features: a round pleated rosette with two ribbon tails hanging down, a plain round golden center with no text or number
cards.pose: The rosette is tilted diagonally, tails swinging to the lower left

cards.label: Saddle
cards.object: western saddle on a wooden saddle stand
cards.story_detail: a checkered saddle blanket under it
cards.key_features: a high horn at the front, a deep curved seat, stirrups hanging down at the side
cards.pose: 3/4 side view with the horn toward the upper left, camera at eye level

cards.label: Barrel Race
cards.object: wooden barrel painted in bold stripes
cards.story_detail: a little pennant flag stuck on top
cards.key_features: a classic bulging barrel shape with metal hoops, bold red and white stripes
cards.pose: The barrel stands slightly turned, seen from eye level, with hoof prints in the sand around it

cards.label: Gold Buckle
cards.key_features: a big oval plate with a raised horseshoe emblem in the middle, a rope-like rim, no text
cards.pose: The buckle is tilted diagonally, seen slightly from above

cards.label: Boots
cards.key_features: pointed toes, stacked heels, white curved stitching on the tall shafts, pull-on loops at the top
cards.pose: One boot stands upright and the other leans against it, 3/4 view

cards.label: Bull Ride
cards.object_color: chocolate brown with a cream muzzle
cards.scene: a sandy rodeo arena with a white wooden fence
cards.story_detail: a round padded mat under it
cards.key_features: two short curved horns, a small saddle grip on its back, a sturdy pole base; cute and not scary
cards.pose: Low camera, the bull rears up slightly with its head toward the viewer

cards.label: Chuckwagon
cards.object: covered chuckwagon with a white canvas top
cards.object_color: bright red wooden with sunny yellow wheels
cards.scene: a green grassy rodeo fairground with a few small pennant flags far behind
cards.story_detail: a big steaming pot of chili and a stack of tin plates on the open back shelf
cards.key_features: an arched white canvas cover over a wooden wagon box, big spoked wheels, an open chuck box at the back with a cooking shelf; no horses
cards.pose: Low-angle 3/4 view from the back corner so the open chuck box with the steaming pot is big in the foreground; the canvas cover rises behind it

cards.label: Arena
cards.object: wooden rodeo arena entrance gate with an arch
cards.scene: golden arena sand with wooden bleachers far behind
cards.story_detail: a garland of colorful triangle pennant flags along the arch
cards.key_features: a tall arch over a wide open double gate, a blank sign board on the arch with no letters, pennant flags
cards.pose: Low-angle view through the open gate, the arch towering above the camera
